content: Eelaasa Quuroti Mizida

Gala7aaden Tesibe geetettizasoppe yida nabe Eelaasi kawo Akaabes, «Tani izas ooththiza GODAA Isra7eele Xoossay beyiin hayssafe yaana layththatan tani yootontta dishin sa7an iray bukkenna woykko xaazaykka xaazatenna» gides.
Hessafe simmiin GODAA qaalay nabe Eelaasakko yiidi izas,
«Hayssafe dendada arshey mokkiza bagga ba; heen Yordaanoose Shaafappe arshey mokkiza baggara diza Korate shaafa matan qotetta.
Neni he shaafaappe haath uyana; quuroti nena heen quma mizana mala tani istta azazadis» gides.
Eelaasikka GODAY gida mala bides; Yordaanoose Shaafappe arshey mokkiza baggara diza Korate Shaafa biidi heen uttides.
Maaladonne omars quuroti ukeththinne asho Eelaasas ehida; haaththika he shaafappe uyishe de7ides.
Biittan iray bukkontta aggida gishshas guuththa wodeppe guye shaafazi melides.
Eelaasanne Siraftan Diza Am7eyo
Hessafe guye GODAA qaalay Eelaasakko yiidi,
«Hayssafe dendada Sidoonan diza Sirafta baada heen de7aashsha. Issi am7e maccassaya nena quma mizana mala tani azazadis» gides.
Hessafe guye Eelaasi dendidi Sirafta bides; izi biidi katamaa penge gakkida mala issi am7e maccassaya mith maxizaaro demmides; Eelaasi izo xeygidi, «Zay taas uyana haath ekka yarkkii!» gi woossides.
Maccassiya haaththaa ehanaas bishin izi izo xeygidi, «Zay taas aykko baadhiza miish ekka yarkkii!» gides.

Histtiin maccassaya izas, «GODAA ne Xoossay beyiin taas oton diza kuphpha dhiilleyfenne xaaron diza guuththa zayteyppe attiin haray aykkoyka deenna. Tani hayssa yiday guuththa mith mixa soo simmada hinnoka taninne ta naazi issito uukki miidi hayqqanaassa» gadus.
Eelaasikka maccassays zaaridi, «Aykkoy baawa, yayyofa; soo baada ne gida mala ooththa; gido attiin kasetada ne dhiillefe guuththa uketh uukkada taas ekka ya; hessafe guye neessinne ne naazas uukka.
Gaasoykka GODAA Isra7eele Xoossay, ‹Sa7a bollan GODAY ira bukisana gakkanaas dhiillezi otoppe wurenna; zaytezikka xaaroppe mulekka wurenna› gees» gides.
Maccassiyakka baada Eelaasi yootida mala ooththadus; hessa malan Eelaasi, am7eyanne izi soo asay daro wodes gidiza kath demmida.
Ays giikko GODAY Eelaasa baggara yootida qaalaa mala otoppe dhiilley wuribeennanne xaaroppe zaytey mulekka wuribeenna.
Guuththa wodeppe guye he am7ey nay hargides; hargezi minni minni biin naazi hayqqides.
Maccassaya Eelaasa, «Haysso Xoossa asoo! Ta nees ay iita ooththadinaa? Neni ta nagaraa tana hassa7issada ta naaza wodhanaas taakko yadii?» gadus.
Eelaasikka izis zaaridi, «Ane naaza taas hamma» gides. Naaza izi ki7oppe ekkidi pude ba de7iza pooqe kessidi ba hiixan ishisides.
Histtidi GODAAS, «Abeet GODAWU, ta Xoossawu, qasse hanno tani izikkon de7iza am7e mishiray naaza wodhada izi bollaka meto ehay?» giidi waassides.
Hessafe simmidi naaza bolla heedzdzuto zaqullidi GODAAS, «Abeet GODAWU, ta Xoossawu! Ha naaza shemppo zaara» giidi waassides.
Histtiin GODAY Eelaasa waaso siyides. Naaza shemppoyka simmiin naazi paxides.
Eelaasi naaza ekkidi pooqezappe duge wodhdhides; naaza aayeys immidi, «Be7a! Ne naazi paxides» gides.
Hessafe guye mishireya Eelaasa, «Neni Xoossa as gididayssanne ne doonappe keziza GODAA qaalay tumu gididayssa tani ha7i eradis» gadus.
